description: Self-hosted document service in Rust: fill Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML and PDF form templates from JSON, convert with LibreOffice or Fulgur, and finish with PDF operations in one HTTP request.
rules: Templates use Jinja-style tags evaluated by minijinja: {{ customer.name }}, {% for item in items %}, {% if %} and filters. This is not Carbone's {d.field} or docxtemplater's {#items} syntax.
A missing value stops the render with an error instead of printing nothing. POST /v1/templates/validate lists every problem in a template against sample data.
There is no hosted service: send requests to your own deployment, usually http://localhost:9027, with an X-Api-Key header when an API key is configured.
Send the template and data as multipart form fields to POST /v1/render, e.g. -F template=@invoice.docx -F "data=<invoice.json" -F steps=convert for a PDF.
Images take base64 or a data URL; nothing fetches a URL. HTML is laid out by Fulgur, with no browser, no JavaScript and no network.
